title: Children’s Wisconsin Expands Elemeno Health Across Hospital Units and Clinics
body_markdown:
**OAKLAND, CA, UNITED STATES, September 1, 2026** /


[EINPresswire.com/](https://www.einpresswire.com/article/938618426/children-s-wisconsin-expands-elemeno-health-across-hospital-units-and-clinics) -- Children’s Wisconsin, one of the nation’s top pediatric institutions, and Elemeno Health, a frontline operations platform for healthcare organizations, announced expansion of their collaboration to support most hospital units and clinic locations with trusted, locally relevant guidance, team communications and operational resources at the point of need.


Research and innovation are continually driving improvements in clinical practices. At the same time, new nurses and patient care teammates are entering the workforce at an unprecedented pace. Until now, training models have focused on classroom teaching, with limited knowledge retention.


“We understand that today’s workforce learns differently,” said Nancy Korom, MSN, RN, NEA-BC, FAAN, Chief Nursing Officer and Vice President at Children’s Wisconsin. “Newer nurses have grown up consuming information in short, repeatable, multimedia formats. Just like technology, we innovate to ensure we’re meeting the changing learning needs of our workforce.”


[Elemeno’s frontline operations platform](https://www.elemenohealth.com/solutions-healthcare) gives healthcare teams point-of-need access to trusted, locally relevant guidance, job aids, team communications, onboarding resources, skills development and competency support. The platform helps organizations turn policies, procedures, best practices and operational knowledge into practical resources that help frontline staff build skills, reinforce competencies and apply knowledge with confidence in the flow of work.


Children’s initially piloted Elemeno in two high-complexity units: the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit and an Acute Care Medical Specialty Unit.


“Clinical practice is increasingly complex, and our teams need reliable support that extends beyond initial training,” noted Jennifer Doerr, MSN, RN, System Clinical Education Manager at Children’s Wisconsin. “Providing trusted, point-of-need guidance helps reduce barriers to information, reinforces best practices, and gives clinicians the confidence to make informed decisions in the flow of work so they can focus on delivering exceptional care to children and families.”


“Healthcare is becoming increasingly complex, while practices, supplies, and people are constantly changing,” said Dr. Arup Roy-Burman, founder and chief strategy and medical officer of Elemeno Health. “The result is a growing gap between institutional knowledge and frontline practice. Elemeno’s transformative approach gives hospitals the agile workforce necessary for a future of sustainable, high-quality healthcare.”


Elemeno is the first of its kind — a team-centric platform that provides frontline staff with a personalized resource hub they can consult for bedside care, 24/7, on any device. Healthcare systems around the country have demonstrated shortened onboarding and training times (over 40%), improved staff retention (up to 50%), and reduced medical errors and hospital-acquired conditions (up to 75%). Elemeno is used across more than 100 hospitals, clinics and agencies nationwide. Its Shared Resource Network includes more than 40,000 resources that healthcare organizations can draw from and adapt to their own policies, workflows and local needs.


**About Children’s Wisconsin**


Children’s Wisconsin is the region’s only independent health care system dedicated solely to the health and well-being of children. The system offers a wide range of care and support for children of all ages. Children’s services include medical care, dental care, child and family counseling, foster care, adoption, social services, child advocacy and injury prevention. Learn more at


[childrenswi.org](http://childrenswi.org/)


**About Elemeno Health**


Founded by clinicians in 2016, Elemeno Health is a Public Benefit Corporation that helps healthcare organizations prepare, support and enable frontline teams in the flow of work. Its cloud-based frontline operations platform gives staff point-of-need access to trusted, locally relevant guidance, job aids, communications, onboarding resources, skills development and competency support. Elemeno helps organizations standardize best practices, accelerate workforce readiness and strengthen operational consistency while allowing hospitals, departments and units to adapt resources to their local workflows and needs. Learn more at elemenohealth.com.
